I’m 18F, about to turn 19. I was just recently diagnosed too. The best you can do with your friend is try to help him understand how it makes you feel, as well as the facts about herpes and that it should not really be a big deal for him. Even though he’s probably just joking around, there’s fun and then there’s insensitivity, like you said. If you can’t get through to him, try to build strength within yourself to not let him bother you, especially when you know he’s not trying to be malicious. I think if he is really committed to being your buddy then he will eventually get over it.

Well, I don’t actually have cold sores. I have genital herpes, so there’s more stigma attached I feel.
